hypothesis: Dealer gamma regime: when the prior-day S&P 500 GEX is low relative to its trailing year, dealer hedging amplifies intraday moves (trend); when it is high, hedging dampens them (reversal). Expected sign: the slope of rest-of-day return on first-hour return is higher in the LOW regime than in the HIGH regime.
disclosure_before_freeze: GEX file inspected only for schema, date range, gaps and the share of negative values (8.9% overall, 11% since 2019-05). No return of any instrument was computed with GEX.
Prior repo result: mnq_close_hedging_flow (rest-of-day vs last 30 minutes, no GEX) was rejected. This study uses a different window and a new conditioning variable.
MES price/volume campaigns are closed; this test adds an external information source and has no tunable threshold.

gex.source: https://squeezemetrics.com/monitor/static/DIX.csv retrieved 2026-11-11; local research use only, not redistributed (gitignored)

session.eligibility: at least 370 of 390 one-minute bars, and bars at 09:30, 10:29 and 15:59 present (excludes half days)

variables.r_am: ln(close of 10:29 bar / open of 09:30 bar)
variables.r_pm: ln(close of 15:59 bar / close of 10:29 bar)
variables.rv: sum of squared 5-minute log returns of RTH closes (5-minute grid built from one-minute closes, first return from the 09:30 open)
variables.sigma_scale: sqrt(mean rv over the 20 previous eligible sessions); r_am and r_pm are divided by it (causal); sessions without 20 prior values are dropped
variables.efficiency: abs(ln(close 15:59 / open 09:30)) / sum of abs(5-minute log returns)
variables.gex_lag1: gex of the latest GEX row with date strictly before the session date
variables.gex_lag2: gex of the GEX row immediately preceding the lag1 row (robustness to publication timing)
variables.gex_pct: percentile rank of the selected GEX value within the 252 GEX rows ending at that row, inclusive (rank / 252); rows with fewer than 252 history are dropped
variables.regime: LOW if gex_pct <= 1/3, HIGH if gex_pct > 2/3, MID otherwise

controls.ln_vix_prev: ln of VIX close of the latest VIX date strictly before the session date
controls.ln_rv_prev: ln(rv) of the previous eligible session
controls.ln_rv_5: ln(mean rv of the previous 5 eligible sessions)
controls.eff_20: mean efficiency of the previous 20 eligible sessions

H2_primary.model: OLS z_pm = sum_k a_k D_k + sum_k b_k D_k z_am, k in {LOW, MID, HIGH}, z = r / sigma_scale
H2_primary.statistic: b_LOW - b_HIGH with Newey-West HAC standard error, 5 lags

H2b_efficiency.model: OLS efficiency = a + c_LOW LOW + c_HIGH HIGH + d1 ln_vix_prev + d2 eff_20, HAC 5 lags

H1_volatility_informative_only.model: OLS ln(rv) = a + c_LOW LOW + c_HIGH HIGH + d1 ln_rv_prev + d2 ln_rv_5 + d3 ln_vix_prev, HAC 5 lags
H1_volatility_informative_only.role: reported, not part of the gate (not directly tradable; possible sizing input)

canonical_rule.description: Single rule implied by the hypothesis, no parameter: at 10:30 ET (proxy: close of 10:29 bar), on LOW days trade MES in the direction of sign(r_am); on HIGH days trade against it; MID days flat; r_am == 0 flat; exit at close of 15:59 bar.
canonical_rule.contract: MES, point value 5 USD, tick 0.25 = 1.25 USD
canonical_rule.cost_detail: 1 tick slippage per side + 1.25 USD commission per side

all_required_on_IS: H2_primary: b_LOW - b_HIGH > 0 with one-sided HAC t >= 1.645
H2_lag2: same sign with HAC t >= 1.0
canonical_rule: IS mean net USD per trade > 0
gate_to_phase_2.if_pass: the same frozen code is applied once to OOS as a verdict; no change of variable, window, regime cut or rule
gate_to_phase_2.if_fail: OOS is not computed; hypothesis closed as REJECT_MECHANISM on this data

prohibitions: no OOS before the IS gate is evaluated
